concept.title: Orders API Overview
concept.shortdesc: The PayPal Orders API (v2) is the recommended integration for accepting PayPal payments — supporting wallet, card, and alternative payment methods through a single unified flow.

conbody.p: An order represents a buyer's intent to purchase. The order lifecycle has three stages: Create, Approve, and Capture.

row.entry: Your server creates the order with item details and amount.
Buyer logs in to PayPal and approves the payment.
Your server captures funds. Money moves to your account.

section.title: Payment Intent
section.p: Set intent when creating an order:

ul.li: CAPTURE — Immediately collect funds when the buyer approves. Use for most standard checkouts.
AUTHORIZE — Reserve funds for up to 29 days without collecting. Use when fulfillment is delayed (e.g., pre-orders, physical goods).

section.title: Purchase Units
section.p: Each order contains one or more purchase_units. A purchase unit represents a payment to a single payee and includes:

ul.li: Optional item breakdown (items, shipping, tax, handling)
Custom reference ID for your records

note.p: Multi-seller orders (multiple purchase_units) require PayPal Marketplace or Platform approval. Contact PayPal to enable this feature.
